tagline: Leading independent provider of solutions to the global aviation aftermarket
hero_kpi_rationale: The Parts Supply segment delivers double-digit growth with a 19.9% increase in consolidated sales in 2025, driven by strong demand from new OEM parts distribution activities.

kpis.name: Parts Supply Segment Sales
kpis.explanation: Consolidated sales from the Parts Supply segment, including used serviceable material (USM) and new OEM parts distribution
kpis.description: The Parts Supply segment is a key growth driver for the company, with significant sales growth
kpis.signal: Double-digit growth in new parts sales

kpis.name: Consolidated Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Consolidated gross margin as a percentage of sales
kpis.description: Consolidated gross margin remains stable at 19.0% in 2025 compared to 19.1% in 2024

kpis.name: Commercial Sales Growth
kpis.explanation: Year-over-year growth in sales to commercial customers
kpis.description: Commercial sales increased by $338.2 million (20.6%) in 2025, driven by the Product Support acquisition and organic growth in Parts Supply
kpis.signal: Robust growth in the commercial segment

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to significant cyberattack risks. Although AAR maintains documented security policies and uses the NIST framework, it operates in a constantly evolving threat environment requiring multi-layered defense, continuous monitoring, and third-party managed security services.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a competitive global aerospace aftermarket. It faces significant competition from other solution providers in the commercial and defense aerospace markets.

risks.title: Regulation
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict regulations from the FAA and other aerospace and defense regulatory bodies. Regulatory changes could impact its operations, PMA certifications, and revenues.

risks.title: Dependence on Government Contracts
risks.score_rationale: The company is significantly dependent on government contracts, including the ten-year INL/A WASS contract with the U.S. Department of State and defense contracts. Modifications or cancellations of these contracts could have a material impact on revenues.

risks.title: Geopolitical
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a volatile geopolitical environment with activities in over 20 countries. Geopolitical conflicts, trade tensions, and international regulatory changes could affect its operations and revenues.

risks.title: Key Person
risks.score_rationale: The company relies on its leadership, particularly CEO John C. Holmes. The loss of key personnel could impact the company's strategic direction and operations.

ai_positioning.summary: AAR CORP. mentions artificial intelligence in the context of its Trax software platform, acquired in 2023. Trax offers a complete suite of paperless mobile applications that are automating MRO workflows with artificial intelligence. The company is investing in digital technologies to transform service delivery and the aviation industry.
evidence: Trax has the first fully cloud-based electronic enterprise resource platform for the MRO industry and also offers a full suite of paperless mobility apps that are in process of automating MRO workflows with artificial intelligence.
We have made further investments to continue to strengthen our existing businesses, including in digital technologies, to help transform our service delivery and the aviation industry.
